Blog body is rendered via dangerouslySetInnerHTML — acceptable per problem statement (admin-only trusted authors) but consider DOMPurify sanitization if authoring is ever opened up to non-admins.
server.py is growing large; the Blogs section (~lines 852-1000) is well-scoped but the overall file should be split into routers when it crosses ~800 lines.
